title: Analytics Engineer - Remote
description:
WHO WE ARE:

BaubleBar designs accessories that make life more fun. Founded in 2010, the Company is known for its statement-making styles that create joy and bring people together. Today, BaubleBar's unabashedly optimistic perspective can be found across multiple accessory categories that are sold direct to consumer and at 8,500+ retail stores globally.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our Data Analytics team and help build and maintain the data foundation that supports reporting and decision-making across the organization.

This is a hands-on, early-to-mid-career role for someone with an excellent foundation in SQL, data modeling, and modern analytics engineering practices. The Analytics Engineer will work closely with analytics leadership to translate business requirements into reliable, scalable data models while developing deeper technical and business expertise.

Our current data stack includes Fivetran, dbt, GitHub, Snowflake, and Power BI. Experience with our exact technology stack is not required. Strong technical fundamentals, sound data-modeling instincts, and the ability to learn quickly are more important than experience with a particular platform.

WHAT WE WANT YOU TO DO:

Data Modeling & Analytics Engineering


Write clean, efficient, and maintainable SQL to transform raw business data into reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Develop and maintain staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, and reporting-layer data models
Translate business requirements and established architecture into production data models
Apply dimensional modeling concepts with a strong understanding of grain, relationships, and dependencies
Refactor and improve existing SQL and data models as business requirements evolve
Enhance existing data models for self-service and AI-powered analytics by improving metadata, descriptions, and semantic context for tools such as Snowflake Cortex AI
Build and maintain data-quality tests and documentation


Development & Version Control


Use Git and GitHub to manage analytics code through branches, commits, pull requests, code reviews, and deployment workflows
Develop and test changes before deploying them to production
Evaluate upstream and downstream dependencies before modifying existing models
Follow established SQL, dbt, documentation, and version-control standards


Data Quality & Troubleshooting


Investigate data-quality issues and discrepancies between reporting and source systems
Trace data through source, transformation, and reporting layers to identify root causes
Troubleshoot failed transformations and scheduled analytics jobs
Validate changes and develop sustainable solutions rather than relying on manual fixes or workarounds


Business Intelligence & Business Partnership


Support the data and semantic models used for business intelligence and self-service analytics
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and determine the appropriate underlying data structure
Help maintain consistent definitions and calculations for key business metrics
Develop an understanding of key business processes across E-Commerce, Wholesale, Merchandising, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance


WHAT WE WANT TO SEE:

Excellent SQL skills are the most important technical qualifications for this position.

You should be comfortable working with complex SQL involving joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, conditional logic, and multi-step transformations. Just as importantly, you should understand what your SQL is doing to the underlying data and be able to reason about grain, relationships, cardinality, duplication, nulls, and unexpected results.

Candidates should also have:


Approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related field
Strong understanding of relational data and data modeling concepts
Experience transforming operational data into structured datasets used for analytics and reporting
Practical experience using Git for version control and collaborative development
Experience working with a SQL-based cloud data warehouse or relational database
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to break complex data problems into logical, testable steps
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Curiosity about how business processes generate and affect data
Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and business domains quickly
Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience
Position will be remote (residing anywhere in the United States and authorized to work in the U.S.)


Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:


dbt or another SQL-based data transformation framework
Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or another modern cloud data platform
Power BI, Sigma, Tableau, Looker, or another BI platform
Fivetran or another ELT/data integration platform
Python, APIs, SFTP/file-based integrations, or semi-structured data
Retail, e-commerce, wholesale, inventory, supply chain, or financial data
NetSuite, Shopify, Amazon, Klaviyo, or similar business platforms


WHAT WE OFFER:


Starting salary range for this role is $105,000-$115,000. Starting offer within that range will factor in work location, skills, background and years of relevant experience
Generous benefit package including: Outstanding company contribution towards employee premiums for Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, PTO, 10 paid Company Holidays, Company paid Life Insurance & more!
Company laptop, free monthly product allowance and employee discounts

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You'll Do

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own analytics for the Machine Infrastructure Supply Chain team at CoreWeave. In this role, you'll build and evolve our enterprise semantic layer - transforming raw data into trusted models, metrics, and analytics-ready datasets used by leaders and teams across the company. You'll work across the full analytics stack, using tools like dbt, Airflow, Spark, StarRocks, Tableau, and Omni to deliver everything from executive dashboards and AI analyst agents to well-defined, reusable data models. You'll partner closely with data engineering, finance, product, and operations to define shared business logic and ensure data is clear, consistent, and decision-ready. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to shape how the company understands its data and how decisions get made.

Analyze inventory trends and generate reports to drive decision-making and support supply chain optimization.

Proven ability to translate complex data into trusted models, metrics, and visualizations used by senior stakeholders.


Preferred


Experience building and operating production data pipelines or data platforms, with strong software engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, code review).
Deep hands-on experience with stream processing and transport systems (e.g., Flink, Kafka), including performance tuning and failure debugging.
Familiarity with open table formats such as Iceberg, Hudi, Delta, or Paimon, including an understanding of how they impact data modeling, reliability, and analytics performance.

title: Analytics Lead, Deposit Fraud Risk

The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform.

This individual will be the representative of the Credit Risk org, leading the charge on refining our Identity Verification and Fraud processes as well as our Application flow. Develop and optimize fraud rules, policies, thresholds, models, and decision strategies that balance loss prevention, customer experience, operational capacity, and product growth.

Lead testing and performance measurement of fraud strategy changes, including rule launches, model updates, policy changes, and new product controls, with clear pre- and post-implementation evaluation.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Fraud Operations, and Risk to improve fraud strategies, strengthen operational feedback loops, and support new product launches.

title: Senior PL/SQL ETL Developer
description:
Job Description

Senior PL/SQL ETL Developer: A 12+ years data professional responsible for designing, building, and optimizing Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) workflows. Operating primarily within Oracle Database environments, leverage Oracle's proprietary PL/SQL (Procedural Language/Structured Query Language) to move massive datasets from transactional systems (OLTP) into analytical data warehouses (OLAP).

Core Responsibilities And Skills


Data Extraction & Ingestion: Pulling raw data from diverse sources including flat files, APIs, external cloud architectures, and legacy databases.
Data Transformation: Writing sophisticated stored procedures, functions, packages, and database triggers to clean, aggregate, format, and validate business data.
Data Loading: Efficiently inserting the transformed data into data warehouses using bulk processing techniques like FORALL statements, bulk collections, and Oracle's BULK COLLECT architecture to minimize context switching between the SQL and PL/SQL engines.
Performance Tuning: Analyzing execution plans, optimizing slow-running queries, configuring proper indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap), partitioning tables, and rewriting code to manage enterprise-scale workloads.
Oracle Database & PL/SQL: Mastery of relational database management systems (RDBMS), database design, explicit/implicit cursors, collection types, exception handling, and analytical SQL window functions. [1, 2, 3]
Dedicated ETL Tools: While PL/SQL itself acts as a native programmatic ETL engine, professionals frequently collaborate with enterprise ETL suites such as Informatica PowerCenter, Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), or Talend.
Scripting & Automation: Creating Linux/Unix shell scripts and utilizing scheduling engines (such as Control-M, Autosys, or cron jobs) to automate nightly or streaming batch pipelines.
Tools & Utilities: Deep familiarity with development tools (TOAD, SQL Developer, SQL Navigator) and shell scripting (Unix/Linux) for batch automation.
Data Warehousing Concepts: Deep understanding of dimensional modeling, specifically Star Schemas, Snowflake Schemas, and Slowing Changing Dimensions (SCD Types 1, 2, and 3)

title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Preferred Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes.

With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code. You'll learn the customer's job before you automate it. Most AI projects fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a spec, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements step is the bug. So we remove it.

As an Associate Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll join each engagement paired with a Senior FDE. Together you'll spend time alongside the client to understand their workflow and business needs. Then you'll help rebuild that work from first principles, and write real production code for it. You won't start from zero: every engagement begins from a Blueprint that has already shipped for a customer in that industry, and what you learn in the field goes back into it.

This role is for early-career engineers who want to learn how AI gets deployed in the real world — and who'd rather learn by building than by watching.

What You'll Need:

A degree in computer science, engineering or another STEM field
0–2 years of experience; internships, co-ops and research
You built projects, where you integrated AI as a part of your SDLC (internship, research or hackathon entry) that you can walk us through in depth: what worked, what broke, and what you'd change
Hands-on Claude Code basics
Strong programming fundamentals in Python or TypeScript
Curiosity and speed of learning — you pick up unfamiliar subjects quickly and ask good questions, especially about how real businesses work
Good commication skills - ability to explain complex technical subjects to non-engineers
Willingness to spend real time learning a client's job before you write code. It's the most unusual part of this role, and the most valuable
Location & Work Arrangement: This role requires working on-site from our New York office 3 days per week



Great If You Have:

Cloud basics: AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, CI/CD AI/ML coursework or foundations
Comfort with ambiguity — our engagements start open-ended by design Interest or coursework in financial services, insurance, healthcare or asset management
Data pipelines or SQL; classical ML or MLOps (PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow); infrastructure-as-code
Open-source contributions, hackathon projects or public writing on applied AI
Claude certification or AWS certification



What You'll Learn:

How to deploy LLM and agentic systems into regulated production — banks, insurers, health systems
How to build evaluation harnesses: defining what "working" means, then measuring it
Cloud delivery on AWS Claude Code in production, working toward Claude certification
A real business domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset management
How to work with clients: their operators, engineers and executives



Your first 90 days:

Foundations — onboarding into our Blueprints, our delivery stack (Claude Code, AWS) and how we build evals, plus a primer on your first client's industry
The seat — join an engagement with your senior FDE. Shadow the operator, then do the work yourself
Your first piece — own a scoped part of a production system, with code review and your senior FDE beside you



What You'll Do

Take the seat — learn a client's function from the inside, and help redesign it alongside your senior FDE and the Forward Deployed Executive
Build — ship production code for LLM applications, agentic workflows, and retrieval and extraction pipelines
Build the evaluation harness before the feature — define what working means, then measure it
Take systems to production on AWS, and feed what you learn back into the Blueprint
Grow into ownership — your team is measured by the client's business results, not by hours. Drive adoption, because a system nobody uses hasn't shipped — and build credibility with the client's engineers and operators



What you'll get:

A senior FDE paired with you on every engagement, a named mentor accountable for your growth
Regular feedback and a clear path to Forward Deployed Engineer
Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
Real production experience in regulated industries most early-career engineers never see
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions
Full-time model
Unlimited Vacation policy
Generous health, vision, and dental insurance
401(K) matching plan
Salary base range: $120-145k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data.



How We Hire

Technical task — Complete a practical engineering task to demonstrate your programming fundamentals, problem-solving skills, and ability to work with AI-powered solutions.
Intro conversation — Discuss your background, projects, and what you're looking for in your next role.
Task discussion — Join a discussion about your approach to the task, what you'd build next, and how you'd evaluate whether it works. No LLMs are permitted during this session.



Why we ask for a task
We're growing and want to find the right fit. The task is a small investment of your time that gives you an opportunity to demonstrate your engineering skills, AI maturity, and ability to think independently. It also helps us verify that we're evaluating a real person rather than a bot. We're not using your work in our products or for client projects.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
